source.force: convergence.json (frozen 37-frame re-evaluation of every pass model)

reference: raw revPBE0-D3 AIMD, 52.026 ps, 10 x 5 ps blocks
metric: AML curve overlap, 5 pairs (O-O,O-H,H-H,F-O,F-H) equal weight, r_max 6.0 Ang / 120 bins; block SD from the 10 x 5 ps AIMD blocks
note: force_score_pct is the global-metric score on the FROZEN 37-frame test set, every pass model re-evaluated on the same frames (not the campaign manifest's growing set); rdf/vdos are scored through score_vs_aimd.py. Both endpoints of every pass-to-pass delta come through one instrument.
stop_rule: pre-registered THRESHOLDS.md: paired frame bootstrap, U95(delta) < 2.0 meV/Ang and L05(delta) > -2.0 on two consecutive passes, force score floor 90 %. Fired at pass 8 (see convergence.json pairs).
